answer: The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the haven of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on staked peer review with spot checks, diluted when peers disagree, rewards vest against future work. Work waits on the bridge until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the velvet of the next round.
